prompt:

There must be NO loose scalloped fabric underneath the yard. White bundles have visible canvas folds and dark ties, easy to read in a small thumbnail. This is a fully furled square-rig fleet, not a fleet with half-open sails or sun canopies. Keep rigging connecting masts and boats.
TIMBER: retain cool weathered blue-grey tall piles and make timber building wall planks, window framing, doors, under-platform wooden rooms and platform edges similarly COOL GREY, with distinct silver grain. SHIPS stay rich warm chestnut, copper-brown and dark walnut. Warm windows and colorful terracotta-red, ochre and teal roofs stay.
Do not add new text or decoration. Same high-resolution full continuous transparent image, nothing cropped. Keep all current expanded outer extents. Preserve the watercolor adventure-book technique, handcrafted rich detail and plastic forms.
